integrity: Analytic proof includes a strict endpoint energy inequality and an explicit fifth-order center reduction. Symbolic/algebraic script tests are reproducibility aids and not substitutes for the proof. Historical priority and independent scientific validation remain unresolved.
scientific_limitations: Unit-weight connected trees with sinusoidal reciprocal interaction; pointwise convergence for all phases; logarithmic inverse-square formula excludes the codimension-one strong-stable set. Does not classify cyclic/weighted graphs, perturbations, or every large-step regime.
title: Critical-step synchronization and the Perron-mode logarithmic law on trees
